messages:
rachel: Quick note from onboarding: sampleapp (ruby) + c# retriever saw corrupted rerank after we switched to new embeddings model. lots of low-confidence scores and duplicates. error: `EmbeddingDimMismatch: expected 1024 got 1792`

diego: ouch. which SDK versions?

rachel: ruby-sdk v0.6.0 used by sampleapp returns `data[0].embedding` as an array of floats (1792). c# retriever expects 1024 and its batch-merge code silently pads/truncates to 1024 when merging retried requests. ruby retry behaviour was to re-submit as separate request, creating duplicate candidates.

mina: any auth noise? retries usually come from token refresh.

devops-bot: [1761234570] 401 Unauthorized POST /v1/embeddings req=onbn-11
devops-bot: [1761234571] token refresh OK
devops-bot: [1761234572] retry POST /v1/embeddings req=onbn-11 -> 200

sam: classic SDK parity + retry merge issue. three contributors: 1) response shape variants (`embedding` vs `embeddings` vs `vector_bytes`), 2) model dim drift 1024->1792, 3) inconsistent retry semantics across SDKs (merge vs separate).

rachel: pasted raw API response (redacted):
```json
{"id":"u9","model":"fast-1792","embedding":[0.0001,0.0002,...(1792 floats)...]}
```

and the c# parsed shape that retriever sees:
```text
{ id: "u9", vectors: {values: [0.0001,0.0002,...(1024 floats)...]} }
```

mina: so c# mapping layer is transforming/narrowing before rerank. that's bad.

sam: short-term mitigations: a) make batcher preserve raw vectors until validation (no silent truncate/pad), b) add an opt-in STRICT_EMBED_DIM env that fails fast, c) require Idempotency-Key on retries so retried requests are deduped at ingestion, d) canonicalize SDK parsing to always surface resp.data[i].embedding as float[] and have SDK handle nested/base64 formats.

diego: i can patch the c# retriever to: map nested `vectors.values` -> `embedding`, defer any pad/truncate until after validation, and add STRICT_EMBED_DIM=false by default. will open PR.

rachel: i'll update ruby sampleapp to set EXPECTED_DIM and set Idempotency-Key on retry. also add a quick check that raises if dims mismatch. snippet i'll share in onboarding docs:
```ruby
resp = client.embeddings(input: t)
vec = resp.dig(:data,0,:embedding) || resp.dig(:data,0,:vectors)
raise "bad dim #{vec.length}" unless vec.length == ENV['EXPECTED_DIM'].to_i
client.headers['Idempotency-Key'] = request_id
```

mina: i'll add unit tests to platform that simulate 401->refresh->retry and assert no silent truncation and no duplicates across languages. adding tests for field-name permutations too.

sam: also, small SDK parity ask: ensure ruby/go/python/csharp expose embedding as float[] at SDK layer and document fallback parsing of `vectors` and `vector_bytes` (base64).

devops-bot: [1761234585] created issue platform#4600 label=devex/embeddings (cross-sdk dim parity + retry merge tests)

diego: PRs: https://github.com/redwood-inference/retriever-csharp/pull/77 (defer-validate-preserve-raw + map vectors.values)

rachel: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sample-apps/pull/401 (ruby: strict-dim + idempotency)

mina: temporary customer-facing workaround: set EXPECTED_DIM in sampleapp, enable STRICT_EMBED_DIM=true for critical rerank flows, and add a pre-commit check that asserts all SDKs parse `embedding` into same dim.

sam: long-term: add cross-SDK regression tests run in CI whenever model catalog updates recommended dims. also enhance onboarding docs with a checklist: verify EXPECTED_DIM, set idempotency headers, and enable STRICT_EMBED_DIM for production rerank.

rachel: thanks team. fixes in flight, moving to follow-up. :rocket:
